prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
No clear effect was seen for sign_in reorder changes across 2 tests.
Adoption redesign changes showed no clear effect in 2 tests and made performance worse in 2 tests.
Finish new_screen changes made finish worse in 1 test and showed no clear effect in 1 test across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path reorder, and sign_in notification, as each has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.8% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Split Layout: Reconstruct the story introductory screen into a split layout to present story lore on one side and immediate path selection on the other. (why: Choose_path has a 23.8% drop rate with a high mean time of 514s vs 8s median, indicating story screen friction before choosing a path.)
1: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Desktop Sync Assurance Notification: Add an automated readiness notification on the sign-in screen reassuring users that desktop pet data will sync immediately upon login. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Add a photo lighting guidance hint with tip delay on the upload_photos screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, contributing to the 39.1% drop at adoption stage.)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Command Hub Redesign: Redesign the home_intro welcome screen using component replace to explicitly display mascot guidance and right-click control instructions. (why: 3 support emails mentioned confusion on how to control or hide pets, and finish conversion drops 35.2%.)
4: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Decision Companion Preview Screen: Add a new screen 'new_path_preview' between story and choose_path to show interactive previews of companion path choices. (why: 23.8% drop off occurs at choose_path, and mean time (514s) points to hesitation without seeing path outcomes.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Finish Stage Desktop Dock Tutorial Flow: Introduce a new screen 'new_desktop_dock_intro' in the finish step with a checklist layout covering tray controls and desktop overlay behavior. (why: Multiple support emails cited post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding pets and desktop overlay misbehavior.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Existing Pet Recovery Copy: Update the headline and body copy on sign_in to assure returning users their pet progress and account state will be restored. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) concerns lost or reset pets upon signing back in.)
7: [adoption, incentive] Pick Friend Companion Trait Badge Incentive: Add a highlight trait badge component to the pick_friend screen emphasizing unique pet desktop animations. (why: Adoption suffers from a 39.1% drop rate and high mean completion time.)

scores.note: High mean completion time suggests hesitation, but layout changes lack direct email evidence.
Strong support email evidence (8 complaints) and sign_in notifications showed strong positive lift (+8%) in previous tests.
Adoption has highest drop rate (39.1%) and 3 support emails; simple hint avoids complex redesign pitfalls.
Finish stage drops 35.2% with 3 emails, but redesigns consistently showed negative or neutral lift in past tests.
Adding new screens tends to increase step friction, and evidence relies only on funnel mean time.
New tutorial flows historically hurt conversion across multiple test types despite support complaints.
Directly addresses top support concern (8 emails) with low-cost copy change on a sign_in step.
Targets largest drop step (39.1%), but lacks direct support email evidence for trait badges.
